title: Relic Guardian
next_chapter_hook: When the puppet's voice echoed through the depths of the relic, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand tremble violently—the fourth page that had never appeared before now revealed a faint glimmer of light.

text.content: Chen Ji endured the piercing cold from the loss of Heavenly Fate, yet his steps remained steady. That formless force gripped his heart inch by inch like an icy giant hand, but his face still wore that harmless, foolish smile. "This place... feels a bit eerie." He muttered softly, as if truly just a servant disciple who had wandered into danger. Mo Xiansheng's cold voice rang in his mind: "Stop pretending. That puppet has already awakened." Almost at the same moment, heavy mechanical sounds echoed from the tunnel's end, like the gasps of an ancient beast awakening.

The wall lanterns along the corridor lit up one by one, the ghostly blue flames stretching Chen Ji's shadow long and short. He walked forward slowly, but his gaze secretly carved every detail of the terrain into his mind—the hidden passage behind the left stone pillar, the nearly invisible crack three feet above, and the faint rune formation scattered across the ground ten zhang ahead. "Nice terrain." He calculated silently, "Enough for me to die three times." This cold, almost ruthless self-assessment allowed him to maintain the clearest judgment even in peril.

Turning the final corner, Chen Ji finally saw what lay at the corridor's end. A colossal humanoid puppet stood in the hall's center, three zhang tall, its entire body cast from some dark golden metal covered in dense ancient runes. Its eye sockets burned with two ghostly green flames, fixed死死地盯着陈机的方向。一股浩瀚如深渊的气势如潮水般压来，陈机感觉自己的膝盖都在slightly发软——但他很清楚，这只是身体面对绝对强者时的本能反应，与他的意志无关。

dialogue.content: "G-Greetings, senior?" Chen Ji stammered, his hands not knowing where to put them, "This junior merely got lost by accident, absolutely no intention of offending—" Before he could finish, those burning ghostly eyes suddenly loomed within three chi of him, a scorching wave of heat rushing toward his face. Chen Ji let out an "Ah!" and tumbled to the ground, scrambling backward狼狈地, "Spare me! Spare me, senior!"

text.content: "[Prophet · Fragment Bearer]" The puppet's voice scraped like grinding metal, harsh and ice-cold. "The essence of the Tianji Record... unmistakable." It slowly stepped back, each movement of that massive body bringing a shriek of metal against air. "But the Heavenly Fate upon you... pathetically thin." Disdain flashed in those ghostly fire eye sockets. "A waste who cannot even break through Foundation Building, deserving of inheriting the Prophet's mantle?" Chen Ji trembled on the ground, eyes full of fear, but the fingers hidden in his sleeves quivered slightly—a tremor suppressing some dangerous emotion. Mo Xianshengsneered心底："这蠢货，上钩了。"

The puppet raised one massive palm, a complex formation pattern emerging in its center. "Let me see... what qualifications you truly possess." The moment its words fell, that formation pattern blazed brightly, and an invisible force instantly pierced through Chen Ji's body, crashing recklessly through his meridians. The sensation was like someone using iron hooks to stir his internal organs—Chen Ji let out a凄厉的惨叫, his forehead veins bulging, cold sweat instantly soaking his clothes. "It hurts... it hurts so much..." He curled up on the ground, voice trembling, "Senior... please stop..."

Yet the puppet showed no intention of stopping, instead intensifying its investigation. "The Tianji Record's mark within you... is almost completely dormant." Its tone grew colder and colder. "Every previous bearer was a genius of extraordinary talent, noble fate, blessed by fortune—and you?" It let out ascoffed, "merely roadside weeds." Chen Ji continued screaming, but deep in his consciousness was a deathlike stillness. Every probe from the puppet left精确的数据 in his mind: power fluctuation range, rune operation frequency, possible weakness distribution... He recorded everything, every bit, clearly.

choice.prompt: The puppet's investigation continued, Chen Ji's screams echoing in the spacious hall. Yet at this life-and-death moment, he must make a choice between two directions—

choices.text: Fight it out to the end
choices.description: Continue pretending to be atrash, wait for the puppet to fully relax its guard before launching a counterattack with the Tianji Record, deciding victory with one strike
choices.visible_cost: Endure more pain, possibly miss the best counterattack timing
choices.visible_reward: The puppet fully exposes its weaknesses, gaining a fatal strike opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, swallowing that钻心的剧痛 completely into his stomach. His screams became even more miserable, his body convulsing violently, as if about to faint at any moment. "No... no more..." He begged with all his strength, "I'll say anything... I'm just atrash, please spare me..." The puppet'sscoffed声 echoed through the hall, that massive body slowly straightening up, seemingly completely believing its own judgment.

choices.description: While the puppet is complacent, use words to provoke it, inducing it to actively expose weaknesses, creating opportunities for escape or counterattack
choices.visible_cost: May激怒 the puppet, leading to more fierce attacks
choices.visible_reward: The puppet's emotions show flaws, creating advantages for subsequent combat
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise grasp of the puppet's psychology, controllable risk

text.content: Chen Ji's body still trembled, but his eyes became clear at a certain moment. "Senior..." His voice was hoarse and weak, yet carried a strange smile, "You call metrash... then what is this place you've been guarding for so long?" The puppet's ghostly fire eye sockets abruptly flickered. "What did you say?" Chen Ji coughed up blood foam, grinning: "I'm indeedtrash, buttrash can also see through some things... for instance, you must be very lonely, right?"

The puppet's movements obviously paused, those two ghost fire-like eyeballs剧烈跳动了两下. "Lonely?" Its voice carried a hint of confusion, "I am an ancient relic, born only to守护 the Prophet's legacy—what loneliness?" Chen Ji struggled to sit up from the ground, covered in bloodstains and dust, but those eyes shone brilliantly. "Because..." He wiped the blood at the corner of his mouth, "You clearly detected the Tianji Record's aura, yet still probed me in this way—if you truly only valued strength, you would have acted long ago. Why bother talking so much with me?"

dialogue.content: "What you've been waiting for... is never the strong." Chen Ji slowly stood up, swaying yet with fiery gaze, "But the Heaven-Chosen one—and 'Heaven-Chosen' has never referred solely to strength." The puppet fell silent for a moment, that massive body slowly stepping back. "Interesting." Its tone was no longer as contemptuous as before, "Then tell me, what is 'Heaven-Chosen'?" Chen Ji faced those ghost fire-burning eyes, his lips curving into a meaningful arc: "Since senior asks this question, it means you yourself cannot answer it—right?"

text.content: The hall's atmosphere suddenly solidified. The ghost fires in the puppet's eye sockets burned more intensely, and Chen Ji felt as if盯着 by a primordial凶兽,随时都可能被撕成碎片. "大胆!" The puppet's voice exploded like thunder, shaking the entire hall, "A mere waste who cannot even reach Foundation Building, daring to show off eloquence before me!" It abruptly stepped forward, its massive palm descending upon Chen Ji with world-ending force—yet at this critical moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's怀中的突然爆发出一道刺目的金光!

The golden light collided with the giant palm, emitting a deafening roar. Chen Ji was swept away by the blast several zhang, crashing heavily against the stone wall, spraying a mouthful of blood. But his face held no panic, instead revealing a relieved smile—the golden light, though unable to completely block the puppet's attack, had bought it crucial time to dodge. "The fourth page..." He looked down at the Tianji Record in his arms, his voice carrying an unbelievable tremor, "It's... helping me?" Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, but with unprecedented gravity: "It's not helping you—it's sensing the danger itself. This puppet is far older than we imagined."

choice.prompt: The brief manifestation of the Tianji Record's fourth page caused a subtle shift in the situation. The puppet withdrew its attack posture, those ghost fire eyes死死盯着 Chen Ji's arms—the golden light. It was wary. But Chen Ji knew clearly that this faint shield wouldn't last much longer.

choices.description: Risk using the Tianji Record to foresee three hours into the future, which may consume more Heavenly Fate but could reveal the puppet's weakness or find a way to escape
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -5, currently at dangerous low level
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, may trigger complete manifestation of the Fourth Page
choices.risk_hint: High consumption, but extremely high information value

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He abruptly took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his arms, formed seals with both hands, and an enigmatic aura instantly rose from within him. The puppet's ghost fire eye sockets violently contracted: "Are you mad!" It seemed to realize something, its massive body lunging forward—but it was too late. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being pulled by an invisible force, the scene before his eyes began to distort, tear, and reorganize, a blurry image gradually forming in his mind...

choices.description: Since the puppet values the Tianji Record, use the Prophet's legacy as leverage to争取 dialogue or even the possibility of cooperation
choices.visible_cost: Expose that you know more information, may be seen through by puppet as bluffing
choices.visible_reward: May gain the puppet's recognition or partial assistance
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk, but may open new possibilities

text.content: "Senior, wait!" Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice carrying unprecedented composure, "You have guarded the Prophet's legacy for countless years, surely you know better than anyone—the Tianji Record chooses its master, never determined by strength." The puppet's movements indeed halted, those ghost fire eyes tightly fixed on Chen Ji, "What do you want to say?" Chen Ji slowly raised the Fragment in his hand, golden light circulating around him, casting his blood-stained face in alternating brightness and shadow: "What I want to say is... perhaps Senior could try making a deal with me."

The Tianji Record's images flowed rapidly before Chen Ji's eyes—he saw a dim crystal core at the puppet's core, saw his own blood drip onto the floor runes causing resonance, saw blurry text appearing on the Fourth Page... But just as he tried to see that text clearly, a sharp pain exploded from his brow center, the Tianji Record's vision shattered violently. "Mm—" Chen Ji clutched his forehead, blood pouring from his nose, staining half his face. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgent: "Heavenly Fate consumption is too great, it's beginning to backlash!"

But in that brief moment, Chen Ji had captured enough information. That crystal core... its light was identical to the Tianji Record in his arms—they were one! "So that's it..." he murmured, a flash of enlightenment in his eyes, "You're not a puppet, you're... the Prophet's second relic." The puppet's ghost fire eye sockets剧烈跳动了两下,沉默了许久,才slowly开口:"You... what exactly are you?" This time, its voice held no more contempt, replaced by an indescribably complex emotion.

Chen Ji wiped the blood from his face, a meaningful smile tugging at his lips. "What am I?" He slowly stored the Tianji Record Fragment back into his arms, the golden light gradually dimming but not completely disappearing, "I am the holder of the Tianji Record—at least, for now." He raised his head,直视着傀儡那双燃烧着鬼火的眼睛, "And you, have been waiting all along for someone who could awaken it—isn't that right?" The great hall fell into deathly silence, only the pale blue flames in the wall lamps轻轻跳动.

dialogue.content: The puppet slowly stepped back two paces, that庞大的身躯竟slightly弯曲, as if bowing to Chen Ji—but its voice remained cold as ever: "Even if you can guess these things, what then? The Tianji Record chooses its master by its own principles, but its contractor to pass through here..." Its ghost fire eye sockets flared suddenly, "The Prophet's bloodline and the Tianji Record's contractor, both are indispensable." Chen Ji's heart sank abruptly—he finally understood why the Tianji Record Fragment had always remained incomplete, understood why that puzzle puzzling him for so long had no solution. Bloodline... he didn't have the Prophet's bloodline!

text.content: Just as Chen Ji fell into contemplation, the puppet's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of unusual fluctuation: "However..." It slowly raised one giant palm, and in its palm a dim crystal stone appeared, "I sensed a familiar aura within you." Chen Jiabruptly抬头, pupils contracting sharply—that crystal stone's light was identical to the Tianji Record Fourth Page in his arms! "What is this?" he blurted. The puppet沉默了片刻, those ghost fire eyes tightly盯着 Chen Ji: "This is the last key left by the Prophet—originally, it should be retrieved personally by the bloodline inheritor."

Before the words finished, the crystal stone in the puppet's palm suddenly erupted brilliant light, creating some strange resonance with the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms. The damaged area of the Fourth Page began slowly revealing new runes, though only a few strokes, yet they caused the entire Fragment's aura to change dramatically. "This is..." Chen Ji瞪大了眼睛, he felt his Heavenly Fate drain rate suddenly slow, as if some force was repairing the crack between him and the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's voice rare地带上了一丝excited: "Heaven helps me... so the key was here all along!"

But the puppet's next words were like a盆冷水浇下: "Don't celebrate too early." Its voice恢复了之前的cold, "This key can only temporarily repair the Tianji Record's cracks, but cannot compensate for your bloodline's absence." It slowly retracted its giant palm, the crystal stone's light也随 之黯淡下去, "To truly pass through here... you need to find the Prophet's bloodline inheritor—or have her come to you." Chen Ji's mindabruptly闪过一个身影, that sister who disappeared for years, taken away by the Holy Sect... Chen Nian.
